historical_portability: core inputs are traditional box-score stats available across eras

confidence.future: blend low-sample season with prior established level

rookies.no_nba_stats: keep stats_2025_26 null; generate a distinct source-backed projection_2026_27 layer
projection_inputs: current rookie-scale/contract investment prior for true 2026 rookies
rookies.translation: source rates are competition-adjusted, then shrunk toward 2025-26 NBA position priors according to projection confidence
rookies.draft_position_rule: rookie-scale investment is a modest current-ability prior; development profile still carries most future upside
rookies.nba_takeover: future NBA evidence should replace projection influence as real career NBA minutes accumulate

development.display: career stage + trend + broad prime window
development.save_engine: attribute-specific age curve + hidden ceiling + role/minutes/injury context + controlled variance
development.attribute_aging: athletic traits decline earlier; shooting/playmaking/IQ can peak later and decline slower
development.retirement: probabilistic after late-career decline, not a fixed age

overall: 72% position-weighted skill overall + 28% season-relative impact summary
impact: 36% PTS/36 + 19% AST/36 + 13% REB/36 + 8% STL/36 + 8% BLK/36 + 16% true-shooting proxy, all season-relative percentile scores
population: Complete 2025-26 NBA regular-season player population; multi-team players use season-total aggregate rows.

projection_v0_23.simulation_policy: synthetic NBA-like rates are uncertainty-shrunk before Game Day use
projection_v0_23.role_policy: projected minutes are stored separately from historical MPG
